onaddha: [ava + naha + ta] (na) CL=7 (1) Covers or wraps (with). (Ti) (2) Should be covered or wrapped.
onaddhaka: [onaddha + ka] (ti) CL=7 Should be covered or wrapped.
onaddhamauca: [onaddha + mauca] (pu) CL=7 A bench or bedstead that is covered (with).
onaddhapariyonaddha: [onaddha + pariyonaddha] (ti) CL=7 Should be covered or wrapped in all directions.
onaddhapīṭha: [onaddha + pīṭha] (na) CL=7 A bench which is covered (with). See below.
onaddhitvā: [ava + naha + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having covered or wrapped.
onahana: [ava + naha + yu] (na) CL=7 (1) Blocking (viññāṇa, dvāra). (2) Forms (sampayutta dhamma).
onahanarasa: [onahana + rasa] (ti) CL=7 (1) With the function of blocking (viññāṇa, dvāra). With the function of forming (sampayutta dhamma).
onahituṃ: [ava + naha + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To wrap and tie.
onahiyāna: [ava + naha + tvāna] (bya) CL=7 Wrap and tie in all directions.
onahāpetuṃ: [ava + naha + ṇāpe + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To wrap and tie. See below.
onamana: [ava + namu + yu] (thī,na) CL=7 Bending. (A) Bows down. Being low down. (B) Bows down or falls down.
onamanta: [ava + namu + a + anta] (ti) CL=7 Bends down.
onamanthi: [ava + manu + a + anti] (kri) CL=7 They bow down. (A) They bend down. They are low down. (B) They bow down. They bow down with respect. (C) They incline. They bend down. See - Oṇa (na)-mati- (A)(B)(C).
onamanunnamanapakatika: [onamanaunnamana + pakati + ka] (ti) CL=7 Has the nature of inclination and heaping.
onamati: [ava + namu + a + ti] (kri) CL=7 Bends down. (A) Bows down. Being lows down. (B) Bows down. Bows down with respect. (C) Inclines. Bends down. See - Oṇa (na)-mati - (A)(B)(C).
onameyya: [ava + namu + eyya] (kri) CL=7 He should bend down. (A) He should bow down. He will be low down.
[ava + namu + ṇe + eyya] (kri) CL=7 He should bow down.
onami: [ava + namu + ī] (kri) CL=7 He bent down. (A) He bowed down. He was low down. (B) He bowed down. He bowed down respectfully. (C) He inclined. He bowed down. See - Oṇa(na)-mati (A) (B) (C).
onamissati: [ava + namu + ssati] (kri) CL=7 He will bow down. (A) He will bend down. He will be low down. (B) He will bow down. He will bow down respectfully. (C) He will incline. He will bend down. See - Oṇa(na)mati (A)(B)(C).
onamita: [ava + namu + ta] (ti) CL=7 (A) Bent down. (B) One who bowed down with respect.
onamitabba: [ava + namu + tabba] (na) CL=7 Should be bowed down.
onamituṃ: [ava + namu + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To bend down.
onamitvā: [ava + namu + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having bent down. Having bowed down.
onamāpesi: [ava + namu + ṇāpe + ī] (kā, kri) CL=7 Caused to bow down.
onandha: [ava + nandha + a. ] (ti) CL=7 [Dhātvattha. 209.] Should be covered or wrapped, See below.
onandhamauca: [onandha + mauca] (pu) CL=7 A bench or bedstead that is covered (with).
onandhana: [ava + nandha + yu] (ti) CL=7 Covered and wrapped up. See below.
onandhanapariyonandhanaṭṭha: [onandhanapariyo + nandhana + attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of covering and wrapping in all directions.
onandhapīṭha: [onandha + pīṭha] (na) CL=7 A bench which is covered (with). See below.
onandhati: [ava + nandha + a + ti. ] (kri) CL=7 [Dhātvattha. 209. Avanahyayate (saṃ)] They cover, enmesh, and form.
onandhituṃ: [ava + nandha + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To cover and wrap.
onandhitvā: [ava + nandha + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having covered and wrapped.
onata: [ava + namu + ta] (ti) CL=7 Bent down (A) Bow down. Bent. One who bows down. (B) Behave humbly. With down-hearted. One who becomes mellowed in temperament. (C) Low. A valley. (D) Fall for or respect.
onatagga: [onata + agga] (ti) CL=7 A tip that bows down.
onataggatālamūlasaṇṭhāna: [onatagagatālamūla + saṇṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 A tip that bows down that is like a shoot sprouting from a palm nut.
onatagīta: [onatā + gīvā] (ti) CL=7 One who has a bowed-down neck.
onatapassa: [onata + passa] (ti) CL=7 With bent ribs. One who has a slim waist.
onatasahāya: [onata + sahāya] (pu) CL=7 A friend who bows down the waist (and head).
onatasarīra: [onata + sarīra] (ti) CL=7 One who has a bent body.
onatasira: [onata + sira] (ti) CL=7 One who bows down his head.
onatasīsa: [onata + sīsa] (ti) CL=7 One who is with a bowed down head.
onatavinata: [onata + vinata]  CL=9 (A) bent down and specially bent down . (B) Bent down and also erected uprightly.
onatavinataphalabhārabharita: [onata vinataphalabhāra + bharita] (ti) CL=7 It bears fruit that bends down and bends in a special way.
onati: [ata + namu + ti] (thī) CL=7 (A) Bows down. Lows down. Incline. (B) Behave humbly. (bhāsāṭīkā.) With down-hearted. Become mellowed in temperament.
onatiunnativiraha: [onatiunnati + viraha] (pu) CL=7 With down-hearted. Without being arrogant.
onatonata: [onata + onata] (ti) CL=7 One who bows down with respect.
onatunnata: [onata + unnata] (ti) CL=7 (1) A low (place), and heaped (place). Which is uneven, someplace is low and someplace is high. (2) A high place and low place.
onatvā: [ava + namu + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having bowed down.
onayhati: [ava + naha + ya + ti.] (kri) CL=7 [Avanahyate (saṃ)] (1) Covers over. (2) Overwhelms.
onitta: [ava + namu + ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Arises seperately. Should be done to be pure. See - Onītapattapāṇī.
onittapattapāṇi: [onitta + patta + pāṇi] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who has an alms bowl that isn"t in the hands. One who has an alms bowl that is clean and isn"t in the hand (due to remove āmisa). (Lord Buddha, etc.,) who has washed the alms bowl and his hands, placed this alms bowl at a place and sat.
oniyyamāna: [ava + nī + ya + māna] (ti) CL=7 One who should take out.
oniyyanti: [ava + nī + ya + ante] (kamma, kri) CL=7 (They) should take out. See - Oniyyati.
oniyyati: [ava + nī + ya + te] (kamma, kri) CL=7 (He) should take out.
onāha: [ata + naha + ṇa] (pu) CL=7 (1) The dhamma that covers. (2) The dhamma that overwhelms. (3) Covering. (4) Overwhelm and oppress.
onāhana: [ava + naha + yu] (thī, pu) CL=7 (A) The Dhamma that binds and blocks. (B) Binds and attaches.
onāmana: [ava + namu + ṇe + yu] (na) CL=7 Causes to bend down.
onāmenta: [ava + namu + ṇe + anta] (ti) CL=7 One who causes to bow down.
onāmesi: [ava + namu + ṇe + ī] (kā, kri) CL=7 You caused to bow down.
onāmetabba: [ava + namu + ṇe + tabba] (ti) CL=7 Should be bowed down.
onāmeti: [ava + namu + ṇe + ti] (kā, kri) CL=7 (A) He causes to bend backward. The back portion bends. (B) He bends or bows down.
onāmetvā: [ava + namu + ṇe + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having bowed down.
onāmita: [ava + namu + ta] (ti) CL=7 Caused to bend down. See below.
onāmitabhājana: [onāmita + bhājana] (na) CL=7 A cup or bowl that causes to bow down.
onītapattapāṇi: [onīta + patta + pāṇi] (ti) CL=7 (1) Having removed one’s hand from the bowl. (Ti) (2) One who removes his hands from the bowl.
onītapattapāṇī: [onītapattapāṇi + ī] (ti) CL=7 One who removes his hands from the bowl.
onītapāṇi: [onīta + pāṇi] (ti) CL=7 One who has removed his hands from the bowl. See - Oṇī(ṇi)tapattapāṇi.
onahitu: [ava + naha + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To wrap and tie.
onahāpetu: [ava + naha + ṇāpe + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To wrap and tie. See below.
onamitu: [ava + namu + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To bend down.
onandhitu: [ava + nandha + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To cover and wrap.
